title: Platform Settings
prepaymentEnabledDesc: Allow customers to pay online when booking
depositPercentageDesc: Percentage of total charged at booking (100 = full payment)
cancellationHoursDesc: Hours before appointment for free cancellation
cancellationPenaltyDesc: Percentage of deposit forfeited on late cancellation
waitlistEnabledDesc: Allow customers to join waitlist when no slots available
waitlistMaxPerSlotDesc: Maximum waitlist entries per time slot
